services.title: Portrait
services.seoTitle: Los Angeles Portrait Photographer | Daria Zamorskaia
services.heading: Portrait photography
services.subtitle: Los Angeles
services.description: Editorial-inspired portrait photography for individuals, artists and creatives. A considered image that still feels like you.
included: Private online gallery for image selection
process: Share your ideas and the purpose of the photographs.
Agree on the location, wardrobe and visual direction.
Shoot with guidance, then receive your retouched selection.

faq.question: What should I wear?
faq.answer: Bring up to two looks that feel like you. We can discuss colours, textures and visual references while planning.

faq.question: Can you help choose a location?
faq.answer: Yes. We discuss location ideas and choose one setting for the session. Studio rental, if needed, is paid separately.

faq.question: Do I need modelling experience?
faq.answer: No. You’ll receive direction and posing guidance throughout the session.

faq.question: Is retouching included?
faq.answer: Professional retouching is included in all final selected images. This includes colour correction, skin-tone adjustments, temporary imperfections and final image preparation. Complex beauty retouching is scoped separately.

services.title: Headshots
services.seoTitle: Los Angeles Headshot Photographer | Daria Zamorskaia
services.heading: Los Angeles headshots
services.subtitle: A clear first impression
services.description: Contemporary headshots for actors, models, entrepreneurs, professionals and creatives. Focused photographs for the way you want to be seen.
included: A discussion of your intended use
Private online gallery for image selection
process: Tell me where your headshots will be used.
Choose the looks, setting and session scope.
Create a focused selection with clear, expressive portraits.

faq.question: Do you photograph actors?
faq.answer: Yes. Headshots are available for actors, models, entrepreneurs, creatives and professionals. Tell me how the images will be used so we can plan the right direction.

faq.question: How many looks can I bring?
faq.answer: The starting package includes up to two looks in a session of up to 45 minutes.

faq.question: When will I receive my headshots?
faq.answer: The package includes three professionally retouched final images, delivered digitally in 3–5 days. Additional retouched images are $25 each.

faq.question: Is retouching included?
faq.answer: Professional retouching is included in all final selected images. This includes colour correction, skin-tone adjustments, temporary imperfections and final image preparation. Complex beauty retouching is scoped separately.

journal.title: Before the first frame
journal.excerpt: A few starting points for planning a portrait with an editorial point of view.
journal.body:
Start with what the photograph is for. A personal portrait, a portfolio image and a photograph for a website can ask for different things.

Bring a small set of references. Notice the light, mood and setting you respond to, rather than trying to reproduce another person's expression or pose.

Think about wardrobe as shape and texture. A few intentional options are easier to work with than a suitcase of unrelated looks.

Leave room for the location. Los Angeles offers a wide range of visual settings; the right one supports the image you want to make.

If you would like to plan a session, get in touch with your ideas and references.

faq.question: Where are you based?
faq.answer: I’m based in Los Angeles, California, and available for selected travel projects. Include your location when you inquire.

faq.question: Do I need modelling experience?
faq.answer: No. I help with direction, posing and visual planning throughout the shoot.

faq.question: How far ahead should I book?
faq.answer: Send your preferred date as early as you can. Availability is confirmed personally before booking.

faq.question: Is retouching included?
faq.answer: Professional retouching is included in all final selected images. Colour correction, skin-tone adjustments, temporary imperfections and final preparation are included; complex beauty retouching is scoped separately.

faq.question: How are final images delivered?
faq.answer: Final photographs are delivered digitally. Portrait delivery is 5–7 days, headshots 3–5 days, and branding and creative editorial sessions up to 7 days.

faq.question: Is a studio included?
faq.answer: Studio rental, if needed, is paid separately.

faq.question: How do I book?
faq.answer: Send an inquiry with the type of shoot, your preferred timing and your ideas. I’ll reply with availability, pricing and the next steps. Your booking and final scope are confirmed personally.
